issues: The build-up was a grey, small-text fake dashboard gently breathing, unrelated to a music drop, so nothing signalled that something was coming before the blackout
After the slam there was only a plain white Helvetica 'DROP' on a flat #2f2f2f grey, reading as a placeholder rather than a launch line
The shock ring was a solid grey circle with no sense of light, and the frame went completely dead after landing
No brand and no supporting line, so the end frame did not say what was being launched
changes: Custom 'signal red on warm black' look; the build-up is now an arrangement view designed for the shot (Quasar Studio: 4 tracks, bar ruler, red DROP marker), with the playhead moving at a true 150BPM and hitting the DROP marker exactly on the blackout frame

Tension in the build: the camera pushes 1.0 to 1.1 with an ease-in toward the marker; beats hit only the element layer (beat LEDs, meters, marker flag), and the last 12f tighten like a snare roll, 12 to 6 to 3 to 2f; the riser track's wedge waveform makes the build visible

The blackout stays a dead 12f of pure #0c0c0c; three things fire on the same frame: a 300px 'QUASAR 3' wordmark slams 1.35 to 1 (5f snappy plus two scale echoes), a 10px exponentially decaying shake, and a thin bright-core red-glow ring from 80 to 1100px
Added a one-frame centre exposure and a full-width red waveform that bursts outward from the centre at about 140px/f, each bar settling on its own spring into a static waveform behind the wordmark
Settled layout: a wide-tracked red kicker 'THE DROP · 03.21', a 56px line rising word by word and a 32px footnote; the hold has a 1.0 to 1.02 slow push and a faint waveform breath, 136f total
